objective: Fix buildRemediationLink so URL-encoded storefront handles are decoded exactly once before they are encoded into Shopify Admin query parameters. Add a regression case proving that https://example.myshopify.com/products/red%20bag maps to a query value of red%20bag rather than red%2520bag.
acceptanceCriteria: The remediation-links regression test covers an encoded product handle.
The generated Shopify Admin URL contains query=red%20bag and does not double-encode the percent sign.

validationCommands.command: corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec vitest run app/domain/remediation-links.test.ts
